title: AVCC: Audio-Visual Conversation Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction with a Human Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.13957v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: } Predicting who will speak next, and when, is a prerequisite for conversational agents and social robots that take turns without waiting for silence. Multiparty next-speaker prediction (NSP) has been studied on corpora with per-speaker sensors, each with its own event definitions. No public benchmark covers the single camera and microphone a robot has, and no model has been compared against how well people perform the same prediction. We turn AVCC, a 31-hour audio-visual corpus of two- and three-speaker online conversation recorded with a single static camera and microphone, into a public NSP benchmark. We add a speaker-disjoint seven-video test partition with 865 hold and 865 shift events at mutual-silence gaps, word-level forced-aligned transcripts for the whole corpus, and a human reference benchmark collected at the same events. translated_title: AVCC：用于话轮转换预测并附带人类基准的视听对话语料库
translated_abstract: 预测接下来谁将发言、何时发言，是会话代理和社交机器人无需等待沉默即可进行话轮转换的前提条件。多方下一发言者预测此前是在每个发言者配备独立传感器、且各有其事件定义的语料库上研究的。目前尚无公开基准覆盖机器人实际拥有的单个摄像头和麦克风，也没有模型与人类执行相同预测的表现进行过比较。我们将AVCC——一个用单个固定摄像头和麦克风录制的31小时双人及三人在线对话视听语料库——转化为公开的下一发言者预测基准。我们添加了一个发言者互不重叠的七个视频测试分区，其中包含在共同沉默间隙处的865个保持话轮事件和865个话轮转换事件、整个语料库的词级强制对齐转录文本，以及在相同事件处收集的人类参考基准。我们对仅音频的角色相对VAP模型和多模态MuVAP模型进行了评分。
tldr: 该论文将31小时单摄像头单麦克风录制的多人对话视听语料库AVCC转化为首个面向机器人单传感设备的公开下一发言者预测基准，并提供词级对齐转录与人类表现参考基准。
en_tdlr: This paper turns AVCC, a 31-hour audio-visual corpus of multiparty conversation recorded with a single camera and microphone, into the first public next-speaker prediction benchmark for robotic sensing setups, featuring word-level aligned transcripts, a speaker-disjoint test partition, and a human performance reference.
